messages:
Ana: Quick heads-up — while doing the quarterly least-priv sampling I noticed several service accounts with the `roles/admin` grant in prod KMS projects. Not sure who granted them originally.

Chris: uh oh. do you have examples?

Ana: Yep, saw `svc-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `svc-legacy-sync`. Logs show a grant event on 2025-11-02 with an API key rotation mention. Exact log snippet:

```
protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"
resourceName="projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/config/cryptoKeys/primary"
principalEmail="infra-deploy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
``` 

Priya: Can you paste the full logging query you used? I want to cross-check in org project logs.

Ana: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"SetIamPolicy\" AND resource.type=\"kms_crypto_key\" AND protoPayload.request.policy.bindings.members:serviceAccount:svc" --project=redwood-prod --limit=50` worked.

infra-bot: Auto note — rotation-policy alert triggered for `primary` key on 2025-11-01. Incident ID: KC-20251101-7

Chris: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) prioritize removal of `roles/admin` from those svcaccts; 2) identify any runs that depend on KMS admin perms (backup/restore jobs?)

Jordan: I'm owning the removal. I'll run a dry-run denylist and open a canary change with the infra team tomorrow. CC @Priya for runbook checks.

Priya: I'll grep CI logs for operations that call `RestoreCryptoKeyVersion` or set IAM on keys. If we see failures after canary, we'll roll back.

Ana: Plan sounds good. Jordan — can you also add an audit entry to track who re-grants afterwards? We want an ownership ticket.

Jordan: Yup. Creating a ticket now: INFRA-9843. I'll include the command I used and link to the dry-run output.

sec-oncall: FYI, update the KMS key policy to require `kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` instead of admin for service accounts where possible. Also add an alert: `SetIamPolicy` on KMS keys should generate a high-priority pager during the audit phase.

Chris: Agree. Priya, can you propose a minimal role mapping doc? We'll use it as a template for the entitlement cleanup sweep.

Priya: Will do. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

Ana: Thanks all — marking this thread as actioned once INFRA-9843 is linked to the PR.

infra-bot: Linked PR detected: https://git.redwood.com/infra/policy/compare/42...43 — status: open

Jordan: PR submitted, includes rollback steps and smoke tests. Assigning @Chris to review.

Chris: Reviewing now, should be quick. :thumbsup:

Ana: Closing loop — once PR merges, I'll run the least-priv sampling again and paste results.

sec-oncall: Good. Also, let's add this scenario to the incident playbook under "kms-entitlement-drift" so next time it's faster.

Ana: Added a short note in the playbook: https://docs.redwood.com/security/kms-entitlement-drift

Priya: Nice. End of thread.
